mapper.insert: insert into location_nerp select sku, qty from stg_location_nerp;
insert into location select location, item, description, inv_status, quantity from stg_location where inv_status = 'CP' and (left(location,1) ='1' or left(location,1) ='0');
mapper.select: select b.item, least(ifnull(a.qty,0),b.qty) as min_qty from location_nerp a right join (select item, sum(quantity) as qty from location group by item) b on a.sku = b.item;
